hints.tr: `docker network create / ls / inspect`, çalıştırırken `--network shopnet`.
hints.en: `docker network create / ls / inspect`, and `--network shopnet` when running.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**commands.sh**

```bash
docker network create shopnet
docker run -d --name api --network shopnet shop-api
docker run --rm --network shopnet shop-web
docker network ls
docker network inspect shopnet
```
hints.en:
